committees.name: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects specific executive branch employees, members of various federal advisory committees, confidential filers, and federal contractors or grantees.
dimensions.evidence: if the reporting individual is an officer or employee in the executive branch... or an individual described in section 13103(f)(13)

dimensions.assessment: Requires disclosure of confidential royalty sources and amounts, and updates conflict of interest reviews for contractors.
dimensions.evidence: the original source and amount or value of any royalties received by the reporting individual, the spouse... or a dependent child

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative costs for agencies and the GAO to publish lists, reports, and online disclosures, but no specific spending amounts are stated.
dimensions.evidence: the Government Accountability Office shall publish a list of each advisory committee

dimensions.assessment: Amends multiple titles of the U.S. Code relating to ethics, financial disclosures, and federal acquisitions.
dimensions.evidence: Section 13103 of title 5, United States Code, is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing annual reporting requirements, with a specific 5-year sunset on certain advisory committee provisions.
dimensions.evidence: Effective on the date that is 5 years after the date of enactment of this Act

missing_information: The exact number of advisory committee members and federal employees who receive royalties and will be subject to the new disclosures.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill imposes new financial reporting and disclosure requirements regarding government-developed invention royalties for executive branch employees, certain advisory committee members, and federal contractors.
